title: Flask Prediction API and Console

learning_objectives: Explain request validation, response, and UI flow in plain language and connect it to src/flask_app.py; index.html; js/app.js.
Trace one input through the flask prediction api and console stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: request validation, response, and UI flow
practical_outcomes: Trace the flask prediction api and console stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for request validation, response, and UI flow.

Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
